items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: It made me think of Sidney Bechet, who is like with that soprano sax like a laser.

ctx.x: It made me think of Sidney Bechet, who is like with that soprano sax like a laser.
And his vibrato. You notice how his vibrato is church-like? Like, oh come on the Gospel singer, the famous Gospel singer.
